unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote: 19-mashqning oxirgi bo'shlig'ida ('It's a quarter ... eight') audio 'to' yoki 'past' ekanini belgilaydi. Audio yo'q — 'to' olingan va 'past' ham to'g'ri ekani izohda ko'rsatilgan; qolip har ikki holda bir xil o'rganiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Qayta tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Qoida aniq bo'lgani uchun audiosiz ham hal qilinadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKITA 'TH' TOVUSHI — ingliz tilining eng qiyin tovushlari.

IKKALASIDA HAM til TISHLAR ORASIDA turadi. Farqi OVOZDA:

  /θ/ — JARANGSIZ (ovozsiz)
        tomog'ingiz tebranmaydi
        three, bath, both, think, thank, Thursday

  /ð/ — JARANGLI (ovozli)
        tomog'ingiz tebranadi
        this, that, father, then, the, they, mother

TEKSHIRISH USULI: barmog'ingizni tomog'ingizga qo'ying.
  Tebransa → /ð/
  Tebranmasa → /θ/

OSON QOIDA:
  KO'P ISHLATILADIGAN kichik so'zlar (the, this, that, they,
  then, there, mother, father, brother) — /ð/ jarangli
  Qolganlari — ko'pincha /θ/ jarangsiz

DIQQAT: o'zbek tilida bu tovushlar YO'Q. Ularni 's', 'z',
't' yoki 'd' bilan almashtirmang — bu boshqa so'z bo'lib qoladi:
  think /θɪŋk/ (o'ylamoq) ≠ sink /sɪŋk/ (yuvinish idishi)
  they /ðeɪ/ (ular) ≠ day /deɪ/ (kun)

items.whyUz: JARANGLI. 'this' — ko'p ishlatiladigan kichik so'z → /ð/. Tomoq tebranadi.
JARANGSIZ. Sonlarda /θ/: three, thirteen, thirty, third.
JARANGSIZ. So'z oxiridagi 'th' ko'pincha /θ/: bath, month, north, south.
JARANGLI. Qarindoshlik so'zlarida /ð/: father, mother, brother.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps, then listen and check. Finally, in pairs, act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng tinglab tekshiring. Nihoyat, juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada javoblar tasdiqlanadi. Oxirgi bo'shliqda 'to' ham, 'past' ham grammatik to'g'ri.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAQTNI SO'RASH — begona odamdan.

MULOYIMLIK QOIDASI:
  'Excuse me' — begona odamga murojaat qilishdan OLDIN aytiladi.
  Bu 'kechirasiz' emas, 'bezovta qilyapman' degani.
  (Uzr so'rash uchun esa 'Sorry' ishlatiladi.)

  'Sorry?' — ko'tarilgan ohang bilan aytilsa,
  'eshitmadim, qaytaring' degani.

VAQT SO'RASHNING IKKI XIL SHAKLI:
  What's the time?    (What IS the time)
  What time is it?
Ikkalasi bir xil ma'no.

DIALOG MANTIG'I:
  A birinchi shaklda so'raydi → B eshitmaydi →
  A ikkinchi shaklda takrorlaydi → B javob beradi

lines.textEn: Excuse me, ____ the time?
lines.whyUz: 'What's the time?' = What IS the time. 'Excuse me' — begona odamga murojaat.

lines.textEn: Sorry?
What ____ is it?
lines.whyUz: 'What time is it?' — birinchi savolning boshqa shakli. A takrorlayapti.

lines.textEn: It's a quarter ____ eight.
lines.hintUz: Chorak — sakkizga qoldimi yoki sakkizdan o'tdimi?
lines.whyUz: 'a quarter to eight' = 7:45 (sakkizga chorak qoldi). 'a quarter PAST eight' = 8:15 ham grammatik to'g'ri — audio qaysi biri ekanini aytadi.

lines.textEn: Thanks.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and complete the questions. Listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va savollarni to'ldiring. So'ng tinglab tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT — RADIO SUHBATI.
  P = presenter (boshlovchi)
  A = Annie Franklyn, mahalliy qo'shiqchi

HAR BIR SAVOLNI JAVOBIDAN TIKLANG:

  javob 'Yes, I like it a lot'    → Do you like ...?
  javob 'I usually get up at noon' → What time do you get up?
  javob ish-harakat ro'yxati       → What do you do then?
  javob 'At ten o'clock'           → What time does ... start?
  javob 'I love going to...'       → What do you like doing?
  javob 'Oh yes'                   → Are you ...?

DIQQAT — 'do' va 'does':
  Do YOU like ...?        (you → do)
  What time does THE SHOW start?  (the show → does)

lines.textEn: Our special guest in the studio today is our local singer, Annie Franklyn. Welcome to the show, Annie.
lines.uz: Bugun studiyadagi maxsus mehmonimiz — mahalliy qo'shiqchimiz Enni Franklin. Ko'rsatuvga xush kelibsiz, Enni.

lines.textEn: Thanks. It's great to be here.
Well Annie, 1) ____ your job?
lines.hintUz: Javob 'Yes, I like it a lot' bilan boshlanadi
lines.whyUz: Javobda 'Yes, I like it' → savol 'Do you like your job?'.

lines.textEn: Yes, I like it a lot. The only bad thing is that I don't see my family and friends very often. I'm very busy.
lines.uz: Ha, uni juda yoqtiraman. Yagona yomon tomoni — oilam va do'stlarimni tez-tez ko'rmayman. Men juda bandman.

lines.textEn: Well, tell us about a typical day in your life. 2) ____ do you get up?
lines.whyUz: Javobda 'at noon' — SOAT. Demak savol 'What time do you get up?'.

lines.textEn: I usually get up at noon because I go to bed very late every night. I have lunch at about two.
lines.uz: Odatda tush paytida turaman, chunki har kecha juda kech yotaman. Taxminan ikkida tushlik qilaman.

lines.textEn: 3) What ____ then?
lines.whyUz: 'What do you do then?' = keyin nima qilasiz? 'do' ikki marta: yordamchi + asosiy fe'l.

lines.textEn: I go to the club to practise for about two hours, then I go home or sometimes I go shopping. I go back to the club again at about eight o'clock in the evening.
lines.uz: Taxminan ikki soat mashq qilish uchun klubga boraman, so'ng uyga qaytaman yoki ba'zan xaridga boraman. Kechqurun taxminan soat sakkizda yana klubga qaytaman.

lines.textEn: 4) ____ the show start?
lines.hintUz: Javob 'At ten o'clock' — soat; ega 'the show'
lines.whyUz: 'the show' — 3-shaxs birlik → DOES. Javobda soat → 'What time'.

lines.textEn: At ten o'clock, and we don't usually finish until two o'clock in the morning.
lines.uz: Soat o'nda, va biz odatda ertalab soat ikkigacha tugatmaymiz.

lines.whyUz: 'What do you do then?' — yana keyingi harakat so'ralyapti.

lines.textEn: I go back home, read for a while, then go to bed.
lines.uz: Uyga qaytaman, bir oz o'qiyman, so'ng yotaman.

lines.textEn: Annie, I know you don't have much free time, but 6) ____ doing in your free time?
lines.hintUz: Javob 'I love going to the cinema...'
lines.whyUz: 'like DOING' — keyin -ING keladi. Javobda 'I love going...' → savol 'what do you like doing?'.

lines.textEn: I love going to the cinema or having dinner with friends. I don't really like going to parties, though.
lines.uz: Kinoga borishni yoki do'stlar bilan kechki ovqat qilishni yaxshi ko'raman. Ziyofatlarga borishni esa unchalik yoqtirmayman.

lines.textEn: One last question. 7) ____ satisfied with your life?
lines.whyUz: 'satisfied' sifat → 'to be' fe'li kerak: 'Are you satisfied?'. 'Do you' XATO.

lines.textEn: Oh yes. I love singing and I enjoy my free time.
lines.uz: Ha, albatta. Qo'shiq aytishni yaxshi ko'raman va bo'sh vaqtimdan zavqlanaman.

lines.textEn: Annie Franklyn, thank you for joining us.
lines.uz: Enni Franklin, bizga qo'shilganingiz uchun rahmat.

exercises.explanationUz:
Dialogdan Enning kunini tiklab, 3-SHAXSDA gapiring:
  I get up → she GETS up
  I go     → she GOES
  I have   → she HAS

ENNING KUNI — ODATIY EMAS!
U qo'shiqchi, shuning uchun kechasi ishlaydi:
  tush paytida turadi → kechasi 2 da yotadi
Bu Bob (delfin murabbiyi) va Genri (dehqon) bilan
qarama-qarshi — ular erta turadi.

Enni — 'a night owl' (tungi boyqush),
Bob va Genri — 'early birds' (erta turuvchi qushlar).

structure.modelEn: Annie usually gets up at noon because she goes to bed very late every night.
She has lunch at about two o'clock.
Then she goes to the club to practise for about two hours.
After that, she goes home or sometimes she goes shopping.
She goes back to the club again at about eight o'clock in the evening.
The show starts at ten o'clock and they don't usually finish until two o'clock in the morning.
After the show, she goes back home, reads for a while, then goes to bed.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoada ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap 1 ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
Unit 5 ning 17 ta kalit so'zi va iborasi.

RO'YXAT:
  feed, catch the bus, aquarium, in the afternoon,
  go dancing, go out with your family, get up,
  (a) quarter to, go to bed, half past, rarely,
  milk the cows, often, relax, always, meet my friends,
  satisfied

BALL OSHIRISH: gapda Unit 5 grammatikasini ham ishlating —
  takrorlanish ravishi (fe'ldan oldin)
  vaqt predlogi (at / on / in)
  Present Simple (-s 3-shaxsda)

sections.title: Writing — an article about a celebrity's daily routine
sections.titleUz: Yozish — mashhur odamning kundalik tartibi haqida maqola

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below and the information from Ex. 20, as well as the picture from the Photo File section, to write an article about Annie Franklyn. Use the text in Ex.3 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi reja va 20-mashqdagi ma'lumot asosida Enni Franklin haqida maqola yozing. 3-mashqdagi matnni (Bob Ellis) namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  Para 1: name, job, feelings about the job
          (ism, kasb, ishga munosabat)
  Para 2: daily routine — what she does in the
          morning / afternoon / evening / at night
  Para 3: free-time activities — what she likes /
          doesn't like doing
  Para 4: how she feels about her life

BU REJA — 34-betdagi Bob Ellis matni bilan AYNAN bir xil.
Demak o'sha matnni namuna qilib olsangiz bo'ladi:

  Bob Ellis, 29, is a dolphin trainer. 'I like my job...'
  → Annie Franklyn, ..., is a singer. 'I like my job...'

ENNI — 'A NIGHT OWL':
U tush paytida turadi va kechasi 2 da yotadi.
Bu Bobning kunidan (5:00 turish) butunlay teskari —
maqolada shuni ta'kidlash mumkin.

structure.modelEn: Annie Franklyn is a local singer.
"I like my job a lot," she says. "The only bad thing is that I don't see my family and friends very often. I'm very busy."
structure.noteUz: Bob haqidagi matn kabi — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutq bilan boshlash.

structure.modelEn: Annie is a night owl. She usually gets up at noon because she goes to bed very late every night.
She has lunch at about two o'clock, then she goes to the club to practise for about two hours.
After that, she goes home or sometimes she goes shopping. She goes back to the club at about eight o'clock in the evening.
The show starts at ten o'clock and it doesn't usually finish until two o'clock in the morning. Then she goes back home, reads for a while and goes to bed.
In her free time, Annie loves going to the cinema or having dinner with friends.
She doesn't really like going to parties, though.
"I feel very satisfied with my life," says Annie. "I love singing and I enjoy my free time."
structure.noteUz: Bob haqidagi matn ham shunday tugaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkala maqol ham ERTA TURISH foydasi haqida —
Unit sarlavhasi ('An Early Bird or a Night Owl?') bilan bog'liq.

sentences.en: The early bird catches the worm.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: kim erta harakat qilsa, u yutadi.
Erta turgan qushga qurt ko'p bo'ladi — kech turgani quruq qoladi.

Unit sarlavhasidagi 'an early bird' iborasi AYNAN shu maqoldan
kelib chiqqan.

O'ZBEKCHADA:
  'Erta turgan er oshini topar.'
  'Erta turgan — omadli.'

GRAMMATIKA: 'catches' — 3-shaxs birlik -es (-ch bilan tugaydi).
Maqollar doim Present Simple da — chunki ular UMUMIY HAQIQAT.

sentences.en: Early to bed and early to rise, makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
sentences.uz: Erta yotish va erta turish odamni sog'lom, boy va dono qiladi.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: erta yotib erta turgan odam sog'lom, badavlat va aqlli bo'ladi.

Bu maqol AQSh davlat arbobi Benjamin Franklinga tegishli.

QOFIYA: rise /raɪz/ — wise /waɪz/
Uchta sifat ham 'w' va 'h' bilan boshlanadi —
shuning uchun oson yodlanadi:
  Healthy, Wealthy and Wise

SO'ZLAR:
  to rise    = turmoq, ko'tarilmoq (get up bilan bir xil)
  healthy    = sog'lom (health = sog'liq)
  wealthy    = boy (wealth = boylik)
  wise       = dono (wisdom = donolik)

'Words of Wisdom' — bo'lim nomi ham shu 'wise' so'zidan!

groups.explanationUz: Bir xil yoziladi, lekin ikki xil o'qiladi. Ko'p ishlatiladigan kichik so'zlarda jarangli.
Bir savolda 'do' ikki xil vazifada kelishi mumkin.
Savolda sifat bo'lsa, 'do/does' emas, 'to be' ishlatiladi.

items.derived: What time DO you get up?

patterns.formula: Excuse me, what's the time? / What time is it?
patterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, what's the time? — It's a quarter to eight.
patterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, soat necha? — Sakkizga chorak qoldi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Excuse me' — begona odamga murojaat qilishdan oldin.
Ikkala savol shakli ham bir xil ma'no.

patterns.formula: What time do you + fe'l? — I + fe'l + AT + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: What time do you get up? — I usually get up at noon.
patterns.exampleUz: Soat nechada turasiz? — Odatda tush paytida turaman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'What time' + do/does. Javobda soat oldida AT.

patterns.formula: What time does + ega + fe'l? (3-shaxs birlik)
patterns.exampleEn: What time does the show start? — At ten o'clock.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'rsatuv soat nechada boshlanadi? — Soat o'nda.

patterns.exampleEn: What do you do then? — I go to the club to practise.
patterns.exampleUz: Keyin nima qilasiz? — Mashq qilish uchun klubga boraman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'do' ikki marta: yordamchi + asosiy fe'l.
'then' = keyin, shundan so'ng.

patterns.formula: Are you + SIFAT? — Oh yes. / No, I'm not.
patterns.exampleEn: Are you satisfied with your life? — Oh yes.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sifat bilan savolda 'to be' ishlatiladi, 'do' EMAS.
'satisfied WITH' — predlog shart.

patterns.formula: I love/like + fe'l-ING. I don't really like + fe'l-ING, though.
patterns.exampleEn: I love going to the cinema. I don't really like going to parties, though.
patterns.exampleUz: Kinoga borishni yaxshi ko'raman. Ziyofatlarga borishni esa unchalik yoqtirmayman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'really' inkorni yumshatadi: 'don't really like' = unchalik yoqtirmayman.
'though' gap oxirida — qarama-qarshi fikr.
